video

Video. Rendering at the same layer is not supported. Related API: ma.createVideoContext

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
src String Yes URL of the resource to be played. The value can be a network path or a local temporary path (ensure that the path does not exceed the root directory of the project).
controls Boolean true No Whether to display the default playback control (play/pause button, playback progress, and time).
autoplay Boolean false No Whether to enable the automatic playback.
loop Boolean false No Whether to enable the cyclic playback.
muted Boolean false No Whether to enable the playback in mute mode.
direction Number No Video direction in full-screen mode. If it is not specified, the system automatically determines the direction based on the aspect ratio.
Object-fit String contain No Display mode of a video when the video size is different from the video container size.
poster String No Network resource address of the video cover image. If the controls attribute is set to false, the poster attribute is unavailable.
bindplay eventHandle No Whether to trigger the play event when the playback starts or continues.
bindpause eventHandle No Whether to trigger the pause event when the playback is paused.
bindended eventHandle No Whether to trigger the ended event when the playback ends.
bindtimeupdate eventHandle No Triggered when the playback progress changes. The output is event.detail = {currentTime, duration}. It is triggered every 250 milliseconds.
binderror eventHandle No Triggered when an error occurs during video playback.

Valid Values of direction

Value Description Remarks
0 Normal vertical.
90 Rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise. Not supported in Android.
-90 Rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

Valid Values of object-fit

Value Description Remarks
contain Contain.
fill Fill. Not supported in Android.
cover Cover. Not supported in Android.

Sample Code

1. Video Player with Controls & Poster

<view class="video-container">
  <video id="myVideo" src="https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/ForBiggerBlazes.mp4" poster="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1536240478700-b869070f9279?w=600&q=80" controls="true" style="width: 100%; height: 200px; border-radius: 8px;" />
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
.video-container { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }

Bug & Tip

  1. The default width and height of the video are 300 px and 225 px. You can set the width and height by using the mass parameter.
